subject.title: [Feature]: Audit log for agent memory changes

question: What memory mutation audit contract should OpenClaw support for MEMORY.md and memory/*.md writes, including storage location, integrity model, redaction policy, and cause propagation?
rationale: The security value depends on tamper boundaries, privacy tradeoffs, and whether the audit lives in memory-core, a plugin SDK seam, or a broader persistent-state provenance design.

options.title: Design first-class memory audit
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify the storage, integrity, redaction, event schema, and write-surface coverage before accepting implementation.

options.title: Fold into broader provenance work
options.body: Track the remaining design under the persistent-state provenance and before_persistence_write issues if maintainers want one architecture for memory, files, preferences, and tasks.

options.title: Externalize to plugin or MCP only
options.body: Narrow or close core work only if maintainers decide existing plugin/MCP surfaces are enough without a new OpenClaw memory audit contract.

recommendation.title: Design first-class memory audit
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify the storage, integrity, redaction, event schema, and write-surface coverage before accepting implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already routed this as first-class memory/security design and has adjacent memory-flush and Dreaming history.
